questions.question: Wat adviseerde de gemeente Gooise Meren in september 2022 over stikstof en milieu?

judgments.reason: The advice letter of 30-09-2022 on the nitrogen (AERIUS) calculation: lists the defects and concludes the calculation must be redone.
Second copy of the same 30-09-2022 advice letter on the nitrogen calculation, same comments and conclusion.
Case-system record of the advice request (26-09-2022, 'is the nitrogen calculation acceptable?'); it registers the request but does not contain the advice.
The consultant's nitrogen deposition report that the advice assesses; it is the subject of the advice, not the advice.
2023 e-mail with an agenda on housing/refugee reception; unrelated.
Forwarded newsletter input about reception; unrelated.
2019 case record of a building-application advice; other case, no nitrogen advice.
2020 case record of an enforcement request; no content on nitrogen advice.
Secure-mail notification only; no content.
Overview map with no usable text.
Asbestos removal notification form; unrelated to nitrogen advice.
E-mail thread on an objection about odour/distance rules for a temporary permit; environmental advice, but on odour, not the September 2022 nitrogen advice.

questions.question: Waarom is de aanbesteding voor de pilot team vee (wolf) uitgeschreven, en welke partij heeft de opdracht gekregen?

judgments.reason: E-mail explaining that the whole project must be tendered under the procurement policy (open procedure), and that the market consultation produced interested parties.
Market-consultation questionnaire: describes the pilot and asks market questions; does not say why a tender is required or who was awarded.
Same market-consultation questionnaire (export with a respondent's attachment); no reason for tendering, no award.
Same market-consultation questionnaire (other respondent's export); no reason for tendering, no award.
Q&A on the candidate's plan of approach; about execution, not why it was tendered or who got the contract.
Status letter: consultation held because few parties were expected, one party remains and writes a plan; award follows on a positive assessment. Closest to both halves of the question.
Short e-mail asking to plan a meeting with the consultation parties; no answer content.
Comment notification with fragments of a memo on single vs. open tender; too fragmentary to answer.
Feedback message after the consultation: two parties responded, options are an open tender or a joint award via voluntary transparency; explains how the procedure came about.
Memo: about EUR 2M to one party means a European open tender under provincial procurement policy; market consultation first to see whether only one party qualifies.
Draft market-consultation text: pilot description and market questions only; no reason for tendering, no award.

questions.question: Wat was het budget voor de pilot team vee, en is dat later nog aangepast?

judgments.reason: A respondent's answers to the market questions: says the ceiling amount looks feasible but states no amount and no change.
E-mail stating the pilot budget estimate (EUR 1,972,264) and that EUR 2 million is transferred for it, as a provisional commitment.
Project proposal describing goals, structure and tasks; this text contains no budget figures for the pilot.
Letter requesting co-financing: 50/50 split, EUR 986,132 each, total EUR 1,972,264 for the three-year pilot.
Evaluation report of an unrelated nature-inclusive farming programme (attachment); its budgets are not the pilot's.
E-mail about the assessment needed to settle the ministry funds; mentions the financial part was removed, gives no budget.
Meeting invitation; no content.
E-mail asking whether to add an outline of the financing; no figures.
Status letter on the tender; mentions 'within time and budget' without any amount.
Cover note to the project plan: goals, approach, planning; no budget.
Market-consultation draft text describing the pilot; no budget amount.
